mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact symbolic Hessians of the charge-even and charge-odd conservative neutral atom/molecule condensate, dynamic density susceptibility including conversion phases and Goldstones, matched dilute neutral demixing interaction, one exact original-action parameter state at four fixed momenta, and Bogoliubov longitudinal-displacement spectral measure.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q and rational functions over real symbolic variables; displayed finite eigenvalues evaluated by SymPy to 18 digits
mathematics.conventions: Natural units; Fourier gradient i*k; phase action -density*phase_dot; response delta_rho=-chi*Phi; retarded frequency s=(omega+i0)^2; k>0; canonical RWA fields and leading reference mass density m*(n_++n_-+2s_++2s_-).
inputs: Exact original-action parameter state m=1, M=201/100, c3=1/100, lambda_rep=1, Delta=1/200
Symbolic positive amplitudes f,beta and density/phase variables; full quantum-pressure gradients
non_claims: No homogeneous neutral condensate is asserted to be produced or stable
No rate hierarchy, all-loop exclusion, empirical normalization, or rational force law is established
Finite momentum checks do not survey all parameters
Bogoliubov high-momentum asymptotic is a mathematical NR continuum limit; physical use requires a particle-like window below the NR cutoff
